title: Getting Ready for Eid
story: Two weeks before Eid, the Hasan family in Dhaka starts shopping. Rafi, his little sister Mim and their parents visit a big shopping mall and the local market, where Selim has a small clothes stall. Rafi also orders a gift online for his grandmother in Sylhet.
storyBn: ঈদের দুই সপ্তাহ আগে ঢাকার হাসান পরিবার কেনাকাটা শুরু করে। রাফি, তার ছোট বোন মিম আর তাদের মা-বাবা একটি বড় শপিং মলে এবং স্থানীয় বাজারে যায়, যেখানে সেলিমের একটি ছোট কাপড়ের দোকান আছে। রাফি সিলেটে থাকা দাদির জন্য অনলাইনে একটি উপহারও অর্ডার করে।

units.focus: Talk about the family's shopping habits before Eid
units.focusBn: ঈদের আগে পরিবারের কেনাকাটার অভ্যাস নিয়ে কথা বলা

sessions.tipBn: অভ্যাস ও নিয়মিত কাজ বোঝাতে present simple বসে; he, she, it হলে verb-এর সাথে s বা es যোগ হয়।

items.en: Our family shops for new clothes every Eid.
The mall stays open until ten at night.
Mim always wants the most colorful dress.
Dad usually pays with his debit card.
Prices at the local market are much lower.
Mom writes a shopping list every Thursday.

sessions.tipBn: না-বোধক করতে verb-এর আগে don't বা doesn't বসে; never দিয়েও না-বোধক বোঝানো যায়।

items.en: Mim doesn't like plain dresses.
Dad doesn't carry much cash these days.
Selim's stall doesn't accept cards.
Mom never buys anything without her list.
The fixed-price shops don't allow bargaining.
Rafi isn't interested in shopping malls.

sessions.tipBn: প্রশ্ন করতে Do, Does বা Is, Are বাক্যের শুরুতে বসে এবং verb মূল রূপে থাকে।

items.en: Does the mall stay open until ten at night?
Does Dad pay with his debit card?
Is the local market cheaper than the mall?
Does the online shop deliver to Sylhet?
Does Mom write a shopping list every week?
Are these shoes on sale?

sessions.tipBn: অবাক হয়ে বা নিশ্চিত হতে চাইলে Don't, Doesn't, Isn't দিয়ে প্রশ্ন শুরু হয়।

items.en: Doesn't Mim want the colorful dress?
Isn't this price a bit high?
Don't you have this shirt in blue?
Aren't prices lower at the local market?
Doesn't the mall stay open late?
Doesn't the shop give a receipt?

sessions.tipBn: Wh-শব্দ প্রথমে বসে, তারপর do, does বা is এবং subject আসে।

items.en: What time does the mall close?
How does Dad usually pay?
Where does Mom buy spices for Eid?
How much does this panjabi cost?
Why does Mim always want colorful dresses?
Which size do you usually wear?

units.focus: Describe a busy afternoon at the mall
units.focusBn: শপিং মলে এক ব্যস্ত বিকেলের বর্ণনা

sessions.tipBn: এই মুহূর্তে চলছে এমন কাজ বোঝাতে am, is বা are-এর পরে verb-ing বসে।

items.en: Mim is trying on a yellow dress.
Rafi is waiting outside the changing room.
Dad is comparing the prices of two shirts.
The shop is offering 20 percent off today.
A long line is forming at the cash counter.
Mom is looking for a gift for Grandma.

sessions.tipBn: am, is বা are-এর পরে not বসালে চলমান কাজ না-বোধক হয়; isn't, aren't সংক্ষিপ্ত রূপ।

items.en: Mim isn't trying on the pink dress.
Rafi isn't enjoying this shopping trip.
The escalator is not working right now.
The shop isn't offering any discount on shoes.
We aren't buying anything expensive today.
Mom isn't looking for clothes for herself.

sessions.tipBn: প্রশ্ন করতে am, is বা are বাক্যের শুরুতে চলে আসে।

items.en: Is Mim trying on the yellow dress?
Is Rafi still waiting outside?
Are they giving free gift bags today?
Is the shop offering 20 percent off?
Are you looking for anything special?
Is the card machine working now?

sessions.tipBn: Wh-শব্দের পরে am, is বা are, তারপর subject আর verb-ing বসে।

items.en: What is Mim trying on now?
Why is Dad comparing the two shirts?
Where is everyone going in such a hurry?
Who is holding all the shopping bags?
What is Mom looking for?
How much are they charging for delivery?

units.focus: Talk about last week's market trip and an online order
units.focusBn: গত সপ্তাহের বাজার আর অনলাইন অর্ডারের কথা বলা

sessions.tipBn: অতীতে শেষ হওয়া কাজে verb-এর past রূপ বসে, যেমন order থেকে ordered, spend থেকে spent।

items.en: Rafi ordered a shawl online for Grandma.
The parcel arrived three days late.
Mom bargained hard at the local market.
Selim lowered the price by 200 taka.
Dad paid the delivery man in cash.
We spent almost 8000 taka on clothes.

sessions.tipBn: অতীতের না-বোধক বাক্যে didn't বসে এবং verb মূল রূপে ফিরে যায়; be-এর ক্ষেত্রে was not বসে।

items.en: The parcel didn't arrive on time.
Rafi didn't check the size chart.
Selim didn't lower the price at first.
The shawl was not the right color.
Mom didn't bargain at the mall.
The fish seller didn't give us a receipt.

sessions.tipBn: অতীতের প্রশ্নে Did শুরুতে বসে এবং verb মূল রূপে থাকে; be-এর ক্ষেত্রে Was বসে।

items.en: Did Rafi order the shawl online?
Did the parcel arrive late?
Did Dad pay the delivery man in cash?
Was the shawl soft and warm?
Did the shop send a tracking number?
Did Mom get a good deal?

sessions.tipBn: কিছু ঘটেছিল বলে ধারণা থাকলে Didn't বা Wasn't দিয়ে প্রশ্ন শুরু হয়।

items.en: Didn't Rafi order the shawl last week?
Didn't Selim lower the price?
Didn't you check the reviews first?
Wasn't the delivery supposed to be free?
Didn't Mom bargain hard at the market?
Didn't Dad keep the receipt?

sessions.tipBn: Wh-শব্দের পরে did বসে, আর verb তার মূল রূপে থাকে।

items.en: What did Rafi order for Grandma?
When did the parcel finally arrive?
How much did we spend on clothes?
Why did Selim lower the price?
Which shop did you like best?
How did you pay for the shawl?

units.focus: Make plans for the last days before Eid
units.focusBn: ঈদের আগের শেষ দিনগুলোর পরিকল্পনা করা

sessions.tipBn: আগে থেকে ঠিক করা পরিকল্পনা বা চোখে দেখা লক্ষণ থেকে অনুমান বোঝাতে going to বসে।

items.en: We are going to buy gifts for our cousins.
Rafi is going to exchange his tight shoes.
Mom is going to buy sugar and spices tomorrow.
Look at the crowd! The mall is going to be packed.
Dad is going to pay with his mobile wallet.
We are going to shop early to avoid the rush.

sessions.pattern: Subject + am/is/are + not + going to + verb (base) ...
sessions.tipBn: am, is বা are-এর পরে not বসিয়ে পরিকল্পনাকে না-বোধক করা হয়।

items.en: We aren't going to buy expensive gifts.
Rafi isn't going to keep the tight shoes.
Dad is not going to carry cash.
Rafi is not going to order from that shop again.
Mom isn't going to pay more than 1500 taka.
The shops aren't going to close early tonight.

sessions.tipBn: প্রশ্ন করতে am, is বা are শুরুতে বসে, তারপর subject আর going to আসে।

items.en: Are we going to buy gifts for our cousins?
Is Rafi going to exchange the shoes?
Is Dad going to pay with his mobile wallet?
Are you going to keep the receipt?
Is the shop going to have a sale?
Are you going to wrap the gifts tonight?

sessions.pattern: Wh-word + am/is/are + subject + going to + verb (base)?
sessions.tipBn: Wh-শব্দের পরে am, is বা are, তারপর subject আর going to বসে।

items.en: What are we going to buy for our cousins?
When is Rafi going to exchange the shoes?
How is Dad going to pay?
Where are we going to park the car?
How much are you going to spend on gifts?
Which shop are you going to visit first?
